prompt:
High-fidelity designed website UI screenshot, first viewport of rest2mcp marketing home, desktop 1440×900 landscape. A real website frame, not a poster, not a photo with type, not a SaaS zinc template, not a dark terminal, not an AI mascot landing. Light Paper #FFFFFF ground. Clean readable Inter and monospace lettering, correct English spelling, generous letter-spacing so words do not merge.

STRUCTURE in order:

TOP — quiet sticky nav, thin, Paper. Far left: exact custom stencil wordmark rest2mcp from the reference (rest + mcp Ink #0B0B0B stencil, the 2 Gate Orange #FD410B stencil). Flat, no glow, no shadow, no tilt. Far right: only the word Docs and the word Sign in, Inter, small Ink, not buttons. No Sign up in the nav.

LEFT SPINE — a tall vertical count column from 50 at the top to 6 at the bottom: 50, 40, 30, 20, 10, 6. Large Inter or mono numerals in Ink. Every inventory row aligns to this count. This axis rules the page.

CENTER — a long REST endpoint inventory filling the first screen. System monospace rows, clearly spelled:
GET /contacts
GET /contacts/id
POST /contacts
PATCH /contacts/id
DELETE /contacts/id
GET /invoices
GET /invoices/id
POST /invoices
POST /invoices/id/void
GET /users
PATCH /users/id
GET /orders
PATCH /orders/id
DELETE /webhooks
GET /webhooks
POST /payments
GET /balance
GET /search

Most rows are already cut: light gray type, a clean horizontal strikethrough, receding. Between some struck rows, leave empty Paper #FFFFFF voids (blank white gaps, no text). Only ONE mid-list row is full Ink #0B0B0B, no gray, no fade: GET /invoices/id — the row under decision, the only solid black catalog line.

BOTTOM OF THE LIST / THE CUT — six solid Ink #0B0B0B blocks stacked, white mono labels spelled exactly: get_contact / list_invoices / get_invoice / list_contacts / get_balance / search_orders. These are the kept tools. They contrast the Paper voids above.

AT THE CUT, in the right margin beside the last struck row and the first ink block: a clear Inter Sign up control (black pill or outlined button). Sign up lives at the cut, not only in the header.

Quiet Inter lines, correctly spaced: REST endpoints → MCP tools. 50 tools per server. Create a server. Map a tool. Connect an agent.

Palette: Paper #FFFFFF, Ink #0B0B0B, Gate Orange #FD410B only on the 2. No other orange. No gradients. No testimonials, prices, metrics, or fake customers.
